name: @jevelopers/agent-harness-runtime
description: Experimental internal durability primitives for agent-harness

scripts.build: node --check src/internal/errors.js && node --check src/internal/config.js && node --check src/internal/durable-store.js && node --check src/internal/telemetry.js && node --check src/internal/index.js && node --check src/adapters/jev/address-policy.js && node --check src/adapters/jev/attempt-recording.js && node --check src/adapters/jev/http-transport.js && node --check src/adapters/jev/request-validation.js && node --check src/adapters/jev/response-validation.js && node --check src/adapters/jev/retry-policy.js && node --check src/adapters/jev/safe-json.js && node --check src/observability/private/neatlogs-sdk-mapper.js && node --check src/observability/private/neatlogs-sdk-mask.js && node --check src/observability/private/neatlogs-sdk-capture.js && node --input-type=module -e "import('@jevelopers/agent-harness-runtime')" && env -i PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 node --input-type=module -e "import('neatlogs').then(({ Client, trace }) => { if (typeof Client !== 'function' || typeof trace !== 'function') process.exit(1); })" && npm run typecheck
